QuestInfo.name: Victoria Island Dispatch
QuestInfo.0: You have finished your training at #m130000000#. Don't you think you should start doing some Knight stuff now? Listen to what #b#p 1064000##k has to say.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p 1064000##k told you to go to #bVictoria Island#k and investigate the Black Wings and their plots. He says that the #binformant of #m100000000##k#b#p, 1103001##k, should have the details...
QuestInfo.2: The #rBlack Wings#k are an evil group in service of the evil #r#p 2159359##k, who tried to destroy Maple World hundreds of years ago. It sounds like they are trying their hardst to revive #r#p 2159359##k... They're just chock full of evil, so you were told that they #bmust be stopped#k.

0.0: You finally look like a knight. I'm tempted to give you your #bfirst mission#k.
0.1: Head to #bVictoria Island#k to investigate the #rBlack Wings#k. I've heard rumors that the #rPuppeteer#k is up to something.
0.2: You may not be familiar with the #rBlack Wings#k and #rPuppeteer#k yet, but my #bcontact on Victoria Island#k will get you up to speed.
0.3: Find my informant, #b#p1103001##k, in #b#m100000000##k on Victoria Island. Take the #bboat#k from #b#m130000210##k.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the Sky Ferry automatically.)#k#n

no.0: If you still have business to take care of in #m130000000#, I suggest you do it now.

1.0: You have the fragrance of #m130000000# on you, yes you do. Is the Empress still in charge there? I guess she would be, but I can never remember. I am #b#p1103001##k, the watcher of #b#m100000000##k!

yes.0: Oh! I have a note, a note here for #h0#. Is that you? It says, 'Tell #h0# about the #rBlack Wings and the Puppeteer#k.'
yes.1: I'll give you the condensed version. A long time ago, there was this scary old wizard called the #r#p2159359##k. Some heroes sealed him away, but now a bunch of creeps want to bring him back. Those are the #rBlack Wings#k.
yes.2: We've been fighting them for a while, but they're #rtough adversaries#k. Thankfully, they haven't managed to bring back the #p2159359#...

npc.0: You must take a boat to reach #bVictoria Island#k. Get to #b#m130000210##k.
